assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity visual concept of a DESKTOP screen inside Flow, a routine and focus app, in Portuguese. Design an original polished AQUARIUM INTERFACE using these five actual fish artworks as character references. Image 1: Betta Azul; image 2: Carpa Koi; image 3: Guppy Aurora; image 4: Tetra Néon; image 5: Baiacu Limão. Preserve their hand-painted watercolor-and-colored-pencil 2D texture, recognizable fins, colors and gentle faces. These are the SAME fish companions, not generic substitutes.

FORMAT: wide landscape desktop UI screenshot, around 3:2. Flat screen image, no physical monitor, no browser chrome, no perspective. Cohesive with Flow's EXISTING design: dark background #08080a, charcoal surfaces #121216, slightly elevated #1a1a20, understated fine borders, rounded corners 18–24px, white main text #f4f4f6, readable gray supporting text #9da3af, calm indigo action color #818cf8. Crisp humanist sans typography similar to Plus Jakarta Sans. Restrained standard line icons and comfortable controls. Preserve a calm productivity app identity around a beautiful illustrated experience. No fantasy-game wooden UI, gold ornament, neon, glass panels, fake analytics, ads, subscription upsell or money payments.

COMPOSITION: slim application header with the word 'Flow' at left, navigation 'Rotina', 'Foco', 'Refúgio' with Refúgio selected, and a small profile avatar at right. Below, a compact page header 'Aquário' and subtitle 'Um pequeno mundo que cresce com sua rotina.' At the right show a quiet inline wallet summary with clearly distinct labels '1.240 XP', '85 moedas', '3 bilhetes', no separate stat cards. A standard horizontal subnavigation: 'Meu aquário', 'Pescar', 'Coleção', 'Meu progresso'. 'Meu aquário' selected with indigo emphasis.

MAIN AREA: beautiful large aquarium illustration takes roughly 72 percent of the content width and is the visual focus, a single expansive rounded viewport. Side-on 2D aquarium scene, soft blue-sage water, subtle sandy bottom, smooth stones, restrained aquatic plants, warm diffuse light and very delicate paper texture. Place ALL FIVE referenced fish swimming naturally in different areas with plenty of open water, at readable moderate size and different directions, not overlapping and not huge. Maintain their original illustration style, warm colors, distinct silhouettes and faces. The environment is painted by the same illustrator. Avoid a realistic 3D glass box, fishbowl or photorealism.

At the right, ONE calm detail panel for the selected blue betta. A smaller clear illustration of the same Betta Azul on a warm ivory art area, text 'SEU COMPANHEIRO', title 'Betta Azul', a subtle rarity label 'Raro', detail 'Capturado hoje', an input labelled 'Nome do peixe' with value 'Maré', and one accessible-looking indigo primary button 'Usar no perfil'. The fish is a pet and profile companion; do not show feeding urgency, hunger meters or punitive care requirements.

BELOW SCENE: an airy collection strip titled 'Sua coleção' with five small fish thumbnails, matching the five inputs in order, with their names 'Betta Azul', 'Carpa Koi', 'Guppy Aurora', 'Tetra Néon', 'Baiacu Limão'. Subtle selected indication on Betta Azul, consistent charcoal thumbnail surfaces, entire artwork visible. A secondary quiet text link 'Ver todos os peixes'. Keep all important text readable, accurate Portuguese accents, no clipped content, no invented extra copy. Exact primary action and navigation must be clearly legible. The result should look like a credible new area of the existing Flow desktop app, with the illustration as the delight and simple working-product controls around it. This is conceptual UI, not a mock marketing landing page.
